note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.1. TestRFC4724RestartingSpeakerForwardingState proves both shutdown retention and restart stale-marking: startupSweep() retains both surviving kernel routes with 0 deletes and marks both in fib.retained and fib.staleTables (positive); processEvent clears staleTables on refreshed 198.51.100.0/24 and leaves newly installed post-restart 198.18.0.0/24 unmarked (negative); and post-selection sweep deletes only the unrefreshed stale prefix.
